name: sentinel-fusion
description: Board-agnostic multi-sensor evidence-fusion engine for Canary Sentinel. Fuses coarse votes from physically independent sensing modalities (PIR thermal, 60GHz radar, WiFi CSI, WiFi/BLE device counting, ambient light, door-contact/tamper) into a debounced people-detection decision with a 0..100 confidence. Independence-weighted scoring plus a fraud-detection posture: blinded/denied channels raise suspicion, and an uncorroborated dwelling body is surfaced as an anomaly, never dismissed. Allocation-free, no Arduino/RTOS deps, time injected for deterministic host testing.
